title: Ladies in Black
tagline: Sydney, 1959. Continental food comes to the party.
about: A bookish teenager takes a summer job at a Sydney department store and is taken under the wing of its European staff.
cue: Serve the mains when Magda welcomes everyone to her New Year's Eve party.
faces: Hold your head high and order the lunch. The frocks can wait till two.

    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersMagda's continental platterSalami, kabana, dill pickles, cream cheese and sliced dark ryeHow to make it150g salami150g kabana6 dill pickles200g cream cheese1 dark rye loafSlice the salami and the kabana and lay them out on a big board.Add the dill pickles cut into spears, the cream cheese in a bowl and a sliced dark rye loaf, the way Magda would set out a New Year's Eve spread.Goodes tearoom egg sandwichesMashed egg mayo and cress on soft white breadHow to make it6 eggs4 tbsp mayonnaise1 punnet cress8 slices of white breadBoil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise, salt and pepper.Spread over the white bread, scatter with cress and top with more slices.Trim the crusts and cut into fingers.MainsRudi's chicken paprikashChicken thighs braised in sweet paprika with onion and capsicumHow to make it1kg chicken thighs2 onions1 red capsicum2 tbsp sweet paprika375ml chicken stock200g sour cream400g egg noodles20g butterBrown the chicken thighs, then soften the onions and the red capsicum in the pan.Stir in the sweet paprika, add the chicken stock and the chicken, and simmer 30 minutes.Cook the egg noodles and toss with the butter. Stir the sour cream through the paprikash off the heat and serve over the buttered noodles.Rudi's paprika stuffed capsicumsRudi, the Hungarian who wins Fay overHow to make itAs written, serves 4Red capsicums stuffed with beef and pork, rice, onion and smoked paprika, baked in a rich tomato sauce until soft, with sour cream and dill.Heat the oven to 180°C.Cut the tops off 4 large red capsicums and seed them.Mix 300g beef mince, 200g pork mince, 150g cooked rice, 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 egg and salt.Pack into the capsicums and replace the lids.Stand in a dish with 700g passata mixed with 250ml stock and 1 tsp sugar.Cover and bake 1 hour, uncover for 15 minutes.Serve with sour cream and dill.SweetsModel Gowns poppy seed cakeLemon loaf cake with poppy seeds and a lemon icingHow to make it180g butter180g caster sugar3 eggs2 lemons220g self-raising flour2 tbsp poppy seeds80ml milk150g icing sugarBeat the butter with the sugar, add the eggs and the zest of the lemons, then fold in the self-raising flour, the poppy seeds and the milk.Bake in a loaf tin at 170°C for 50 minutes.Ice with the icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.DrinksMagda's New Year's Eve champagne punchBrandy, peach liqueur, orange juice and sparkling wine over iceHow to make it60ml brandy60ml peach liqueur250ml orange juice2 ripe peaches750ml sparkling wine250ml soda water1 bag block iceIn a large punch bowl, mix the brandy, the peach liqueur, the fresh orange juice and the sliced ripe peaches.Chill 1 hour.Just before serving add a big block of ice and pour in the chilled bottle of sparkling wine and the soda water.Stir once gently.Ladle into coupes with a slice of peach in.For non-drinkers, use peach nectar and sparkling apple juice.
